note: runner: work/nes/runner/retro-run (tools/retro-run with RetroArch's init order and a disk control interface); The 2 KiB of N175 RAM sit at 0x1800-0x1FFF of this 8 KiB file and are byte-identical to Mesen's 2 KiB .srm (slot A written), but in RustyNES the game's GARAGE > LOAD list showed slot A empty (proof.png), so RustyNES reads that RAM back wrong.
